violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff member remove a full trash bag from the trash can. Staff member used hand sanitizer afterwards and began preparing cups for beverages
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBER TO WASH HANDS AFTER TAKING OUT THE TRASH. WASH HANDS AFTER CHANGING TASKS. SEE WHEN TO WASH FACT SHEET.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR under counter right espresso cooler, milk was observed at 58f; half and half was observed at 48f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE MILKS.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Observed milk splatter on the interior of the 1DR under counter left espresso cooler
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CLEAN FOOD DEBRIS. ENSURE INTERIOR OF COOLERS ARE CLEAN

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no high temperature dish plate or heat sensitive test strips to verify heat sanitization
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OBTAIN A HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH PLATE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION
